item.title: #12 UW-Eau Claire Tops UWS Women’s Hockey 4-2 in WIAC Battle
item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis.- The UWS women’s hockey team hosted 12th-ranked Eau Claire on Saturday. After ending the first period tied 2-2, the Blugolds scored two goals to take down the Yellowjackets 4-2. UWS is back in action on Friday, December 12th, against Concordia (Minn.) Puck drop is at 7 p.m. Categories: College, Sports

item.title: Superior Police Officer shot; active incident area
item.description: SUPERIOR, WI. – A Superior Police Officer has been shot. Superior Police Chief Paul Winterscheidt says, “the suspect is contained.” The officer was transported to Essentia-Duluth and is in stable condition. The active scene is in the area of North 37th Street and Tower Avenue and the Superior Middle School. Superior Police are asking residents to avoid the area. Categories: News,...

item.title: Three-Goal First Period Lifts Hamline Over CSS Men’s Hockey
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The CSS men’s hockey team hosted Hamline on Saturday night. The Pipers leave Duluth with a win, defeating the Saints 5-2. CSS is back in action on Friday, January 2nd, against Beloit College. Puck drop is at 7 p.m. Categories: College, Sports
